## What is certified

- For `3 ≤ c ≤ 9`, global interval coverings independently certify the unique roots defining `θ_peel` and `θ_Max`.
- For `10 ≤ c ≤ 24`, the exact Bernstein certificate supplies uniqueness of the peeling root; point-interval bisection encloses it.
- For every `3 ≤ c ≤ 24`, the enclosure of `Ψ` on the entire peeling bracket is strictly negative. Since `Ψ` is positive for large `θ`, this certifies `θ_peel < θ_Max`.

## What is not
The certificate covers `3 ≤ c ≤ 24`. A uniform proof for all `c ≥ 3` remains open.
